method: Real before/after filesystem snapshots (size, mtime_ns, sha256 per file) around app.preflight.run_data_preflight() calls, plus a static source scan confirming no reference to app.db.postgres/app.db.clickhouse/init_schema/app.ingestion.ingest exists anywhere in service/app/preflight.py.

checks.evidence: test_preflight_does_not_modify_model_bundle: fixture bundle (source/model/*.json) unchanged after a real EMBEDDING_MODE=real verify_bundle() pass
test_preflight_does_not_initialize_databases: static source scan of service/app/preflight.py finds zero references to app.db.postgres, app.db.clickhouse, init_schema, or app.ingestion.ingest

test_preflight_only_writes_requested_artifact: run_data_preflight() itself is a pure function returning a dict; it writes nothing. Only scripts/preflight.py's CLI wrapper writes --json-out, which is the one explicitly requested artifact.

test_failed_preflight_has_no_side_effects: an intentionally broken manifest (missing telemetry file) fails several checks but leaves the entire fixture tree byte-for-byte and mtime-for-mtime unchanged

not_covered_this_session: scripts/preflight.py::run_host_preflight subprocess calls (docker/nvidia-smi/docker compose config) were not snapshot-tested; they are read-only by inspection (docker --version, docker compose version, nvidia-smi --query-gpu, docker info, docker compose config, docker run --gpus all ... nvidia-smi) but exercising them live requires Docker/NVIDIA tooling this host does not currently have running.
